mapper.sql:
WHERE 1 = 1
AND 1 = 0
AND (mod.CUST_CODE_LV${level} = #{srchEcmCustomerCode} OR od.CUST_CODE_LV1 = #{srchEcmCustomerCode})
AND mod.OD_JOB_NO = #{srchMasterOdJobNo}
AND ${srchCusType} = #{srchCuslv1}
AND ${srchCusType} = #{srchCuslv2}
AND ${srchNoType} IN (#{item})
AND ${srchNoType} LIKE CONCAT(#{srchNo},'%')
AND mod.BOUND = 'AIR' AND mod.BOUND_TYPE = 'EXP'
AND mod.BOUND = 'AIR' AND mod.BOUND_TYPE = 'IMP'
AND mod.BOUND = 'SEA' AND mod.BOUND_TYPE = 'EXP'
AND mod.BOUND = 'SEA' AND mod.BOUND_TYPE = 'IMP'
AND mod.OB_DATE >= CONVERT(DATE, #{srchStartDate}, ${srchDateFormat}) AND mod.OB_DATE <= CONVERT(DATE, #{srchEndDate}, ${srchDateFormat})
AND mod.AR_DATE >= CONVERT(DATE, #{srchStartDate}, ${srchDateFormat}) AND mod.AR_DATE <= CONVERT(DATE, #{srchEndDate}, ${srchDateFormat})
AND mod.PO_DATE >= CONVERT(DATE, #{srchStartDate}, ${srchDateFormat}) AND mod.PO_DATE <= CONVERT(DATE, #{srchEndDate}, ${srchDateFormat})
AND mod.ORIG_CODE = #{srchOrigCode}
AND mod.DEST_CODE = #{srchDestCode}
mapper.select:
/* ConsolMapper.selectConsolMasterInfo : 콘솔 마스터정보조회 */ SELECT TOP 1 mod.MBL_NO ,mod.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO ,mod.CUST_CODE_LV1 ,mod.VENDER_ID_1 ,mod.LINE_CODE ,mod.VESSEL_FLIGHT ,mod.ORIG_CODE ,mod.ORIG_NAME ,mod.OB_DATE ,mod.OB_TIME ,mod.DEST_CODE ,mod.DEST_NAME ,mod.AR_DATE ,mod.AR_TIME ,mod.ENT_CODE ,mod.ENT_BUSINESS_CODE ,mod.OD_JOB_NO ,mod.BOUND ,mod.BOUND_TYPE ,mod.FINISH_YN ,mod.ORIG_COUNTRY ,mod.DEST_COUNTRY ,mod.CUSTOMS_CODE ,mod.CUSTOMS_DPT_CODE ,mod.DEST_PORT ,mod.MRN ,mod.MSN ,mod.ASSIGNMENT_WH_CODE ,mod.DISC_WH_CODE
,ad.CARRYOUT_CODE ,ad.SIMPLE_DOC_NO ,ad.SIMPLE_REPORT_USER_ID ,ad.EDI_MAILBOX_SEQ_NO ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(ad.MF_USER_ID, '') != '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS SEND_MF_YN ,ad.SIMPLE_EDI_STATUS
,destCode.ETC2 AS DEST_CODE_COUNTRY ,destCode.ETC3 AS DEST_CODE_AREA
,( SELECT COUNT(hod.OD_JOB_NO) FROM TB_ECM_OD hod INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL had ON had.OD_JOB_NO = hod.OD_JOB_NO AND had.SIMPLE_DOC_NO = ad.SIMPLE_DOC_NO WHERE hod.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = mod.OD_JOB_NO AND hod.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H' ) AS MASTER_SIMPLE_DOC_NO_HBL_CNT
,ISNULL(( SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(ISNULL(hod.DOCUMENT_YN, '')) = 'Y' AND MIN(ISNULL(hod.DOCUMENT_YN, '')) != 'Y' THEN 'YN' WHEN MAX(ISNULL(hod.DOCUMENT_YN, '')) != 'Y' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END FROM TB_ECM_OD hod INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL had ON had.OD_JOB_NO = hod.OD_JOB_NO
AND had.SIMPLE_DOC_NO = #{oldSimpleDocNo}
AND had.SIMPLE_DOC_NO IS NULL
WHERE hod.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = mod.OD_JOB_NO AND hod.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H' GROUP BY hod.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO ), 'N') AS DOCUMENT_YN
,(SELECT COUNT(OD_JOB_NO) FROM TB_ECM_OD WHERE MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = mod.OD_JOB_NO AND BL_TYPE_MH = 'H') AS HBL_CNT ,( SELECT COUNT(hod.OD_JOB_NO) FROM TB_ECM_OD hod INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL had ON had.OD_JOB_NO = hod.OD_JOB_NO WHERE hod.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = mod.OD_JOB_NO AND hod.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H' AND ISNULL(had.SIMPLE_EDI_STATUS, '') NOT IN ('', 'ERROR') ) AS SIMPLE_EDI_SEND_CNT ,obl.ISSUING_CARRIERS ,obl.OBL_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD mod INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = mod.OD_JOB_NO LEFT JOIN TB_COM_OD cod ON cod.OD_JOB_NO = mod.OD_JOB_NO LEFT JOIN TB_COM_OBL obl ON obl.OBL_JOB_NO = cod.OBL_JOB_NO
LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL destCode ON destCode.ENT_CODE = mod.ENT_CODE AND destCode.GROUP_CODE = 'CITY_PORT' AND destCode.CODE = mod.DEST_CODE
WHERE mod.MBL_NO = #{mblNo} AND mod.BL_TYPE_MH = 'M'
AND mod.BOUND_TYPE = #{boundType}
ORDER BY mod.REGISTER_DATE_TIME DESC
WHERE mod.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}

/* ConsolMapper.selectConsolIncongruityOrder : 콘솔불가한 오더 조회 */ SELECT od.HBL_NO ,od.MBL_NO ,od.CONSOL_YN ,od.BOUND ,od.BOUND_TYPE ,od.CUST_CODE_LV1 ,od.OD_JOB_NO ,od.ASSIGNMENT_WH_CODE
,od.ECM_YN ,od.HBL_NO AS BL_NO ,ad.LAST_POD_STATUS ,ad.CARRYOUT_CODE ,od.CURRENCY_CODE ,od.AMOUNT_CUR ,od.CD_TYPE
,od.ORIG_CODE
,STUFF(( SELECT ',' + CUST_CODE_LV1 FROM tb_ecm_od custOd where custOd.HBL_NO IN(#{item}) AND BL_TYPE_MH = 'H' AND (custOd.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO IS NULL OR custOd.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = '') FOR XML PATH('') ),1,1,'') AS CUST_LV1_REMARK
,CASE WHEN od.DOCUMENT_YN = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS DOCUMENT_YN ,SHIPPER_COUNTRY_CODE ,CONSIGNEE_COUNTRY_CODE ,DEST_COUNTRY ,od.DEST_COUNTRY AS DEST_COUNTRY_H FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND od.HBL_NO IN(#{item}) AND (od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO IS NULL OR od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = '')
,od.MBL_NO AS BL_NO ,od.OB_DATE ,od.AR_DATE ,od.ORIG_CODE ,od.DEST_CODE ,od.DEST_COUNTRY ,SHIPPER_COUNTRY_CODE ,CONSIGNEE_COUNTRY_CODE ,od.DEST_COUNTRY AS DEST_COUNTRY_H FROM TB_ECM_OD od WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item})
AND (od.ORIG_CODE != #{origCode} OR od.DEST_CODE != #{destCode})
AND (od.CUST_CODE_LV1 != #{custCodeLv1} OR od.ORIG_CODE != #{origCode} OR od.DEST_CODE != #{destCode})

/* ConsolMapper.selectFinishYnChkList : 마감여부체크 */
WITH TMP AS( SELECT ENT_CODE , (CASE BL_TYPE_MH WHEN 'H' THEN null ELSE MBL_NO END ) as MBL_NO , HBL_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD
WHERE OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item})
WHERE MASTER_OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item})
WHERE (HBL_NO = #{item.HBL_NO} AND MBL_NO = #{item.MBL_NO})
WHERE HBL_NO IN(#{item})
AND FINISH_YN = 'Y' ) SELECT STUFF((SELECT ',' + MBL_NO FROM TMP WHERE ENT_CODE = tmp.ENT_CODE FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS mblNoStr , STUFF((SELECT ',' + HBL_NO FROM TMP WHERE ENT_CODE = tmp.ENT_CODE FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS hblNoStr FROM TMP tmp GROUP BY ENT_CODE
mapper.update:
/* ConsolMapper.updateClose : 오더 마감 */
UPDATE od SET od.FINISH_YN = #{finishYn} ,od.FINISH_USER_ID = #{updateUserId} ,od.FINISH_DATE = DATEADD(HOUR, ${gmtTime}, GETDATE())
,od.SELECTOR_USER_ID = edi.EDI_SELECTOR_USER_ID ,od.SELECTOR_USER_NAME = (SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = edi.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = edi.EDI_SELECTOR_USER_ID) ,od.CONFIRMER_USER_ID = edi.EDI_CONFIRMER_USER_ID ,od.CONFIRMER_USER_NAME = (SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = edi.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = edi.EDI_CONFIRMER_USER_ID)
,od.XRAY_READER1_NAME = (CASE WHEN ISNULL(edi.XRAY_READER1_NAME, '') != '' THEN edi.XRAY_READER1_NAME ELSE od.XRAY_READER1_NAME END) ,od.XRAY_READER2_NAME = (CASE WHEN ISNULL(edi.XRAY_READER2_NAME, '') != '' THEN edi.XRAY_READER2_NAME ELSE od.XRAY_READER2_NAME END)
FROM TB_ECM_OD od
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT EDI_CITY_PORT, MAX(BOUND) AS BOUND, MAX(EDI_SELECTOR_USER_ID) AS EDI_SELECTOR_USER_ID, MAX(EDI_CONFIRMER_USER_ID) AS EDI_CONFIRMER_USER_ID, MAX(ENT_CODE) AS ENT_CODE
, MAX(XRAY_READER1_NAME) AS XRAY_READER1_NAME , MAX(XRAY_READER2_NAME) AS XRAY_READER2_NAME
FROM TB_SMS_ENT_BUS_EDI_CODE GROUP BY EDI_CITY_PORT ) edi ON edi.BOUND = od.BOUND AND edi.EDI_CITY_PORT = CASE od.BOUND_TYPE WHEN 'EXP' THEN od.ORIG_CODE ELSE od.DEST_PORT END
WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item});
UPDATE ad SET ad.OD_JOB_NO = ad.OD_JOB_NO
,ad.SIMPLE_DOC_NO = NULL
,ad.SIMPLE_DOC_DATE = NULL ,ad.SIMPLE_DOC_TIME = NULL
,ad.SIMPLE_DOC_DATE = od.AR_DATE ,ad.SIMPLE_DOC_TIME = od.AR_TIME
FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item});
mapper.delete: /* ConsolMapper.deletePod : 오더 마감취소시 ECM055(콘솔마감) POD 삭제 */ DELETE pod FROM TB_ECM_OD od LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_POD pod ON pod.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND pod.POD_STATUS = 'ECM055' WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item}); DELETE pod FROM TB_ECM_OD od LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_POD_01 pod ON pod.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND pod.POD_STATUS = 'ECM055' WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item});
mapper.insert:
/* ConsolMapper.updateLastPodStatus : LAST_POD_STATUS 업데이트 */ UPDATE ad SET LAST_POD_STATUS = pod.POD_STATUS
FROM TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TOP 1 A.OD_JOB_NO, A.POD_STATUS, A.POD_DATE, A.POD_TIME FROM( SELECT #{odJobNo} AS OD_JOB_NO, POD_STATUS, POD_DATE, POD_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = (SELECT MASTER_OD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}) AND POD_STATUS IN ('ECM060','ECM070') UNION ALL SELECT #{odJobNo} AS OD_JOB_NO, POD_STATUS, POD_DATE, POD_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD_01 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = (SELECT MASTER_OD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}) AND POD_STATUS IN ('ECM060','ECM070') UNION ALL SELECT OD_JOB_NO, POD_STATUS, POD_DATE, POD_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} AND POD_STATUS NOT IN ('ECM060','ECM070') UNION ALL SELECT OD_JOB_NO, POD_STATUS, POD_DATE, POD_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD_01 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} AND POD_STATUS NOT IN ('ECM060','ECM070') UNION ALL SELECT OD_JOB_NO, POD_STATUS, POD_DATE, POD_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD_02 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} UNION ALL SELECT OD_JOB_NO, POD_STATUS, POD_DATE, POD_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD_03 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} UNION ALL SELECT OD_JOB_NO, POD_STATUS, POD_DATE, POD_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD_04 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} AND POD_STATUS IN ('ECM400', 'ECM420') ) A ORDER BY A.POD_STATUS DESC ) pod ON pod.OD_JOB_NO = ad.OD_JOB_NO WHERE ad.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}
mapper.select: /* ConsolMapper.selectHsnChk : 마감전 입력된 HSN이 있는지 체크 */ SELECT COUNT(OD_JOB_NO) FROM TB_ECM_OD WHERE MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{masterOdJobNo} AND BL_TYPE_MH = 'H' AND HSN != '' AND HSN IS NOT NULL

SELECT /* ConsolMapper."selectLastConsolPodInfo" : 콘솔마감 LAST POD조회 */ TOP 1 OD_JOB_NO ,POD_STATUS ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), REGISTER_DATE_TIME, 20) AS LAST_POD_DATE FROM TB_ECM_POD_01 WHERE POD_STATUS = 'ECM055' AND OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} ORDER BY REGISTER_DATE_TIME DESC
SELECT TOP 1 OD_JOB_NO ,POD_DATE as podDate ,POD_TIME as podTime ,POD_STATUS as podStatus FROM ${podTableName} WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} AND POD_STATUS = #{podStatus}

SELECT /* ConsolMapper."selectConsolBltypeiertCheck" : 콘솔마감 화물구분 하우스 조회 */ HBL_NO ,OD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD WHERE BL_TYPE_MH = 'H' AND MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} AND (BL_TYPE_IERT IS NULL OR BL_TYPE_IERT = '')
SELECT CUST_CODE_LV1 FROM TB_ECM_OD WHERE MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} AND BL_TYPE_MH = 'H' GROUP BY CUST_CODE_LV1
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ISNULL(ECM_YN, 'N')) = 2 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ecmYnChk FROM TB_ECM_OD WHERE MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} AND BL_TYPE_MH = 'H'

/* selectEcmYnSimpleDocNo */ SELECT TOP 1 A.* FROM ( SELECT ad.SIMPLE_DOC_NO, MAX(ad.SIMPLE_EDI_STATUS) AS SIMPLE_EDI_STATUS, COUNT(od.HBL_NO) AS HBL_CNT, MAX(od.DOCUMENT_YN) AS DOCUMENT_YN, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ECM_YN IN ('Y', 'N') THEN ECM_YN END) = 2 THEN 'ALL' WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN ECM_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'Y' WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN ECM_YN = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'N' ELSE 'ALL' END AS ECM_RESULT FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON od.OD_JOB_NO = ad.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{MASTER_OD_JOB_NO} GROUP BY SIMPLE_DOC_NO ) A WHERE ISNULL(SIMPLE_EDI_STATUS, '') IN ('', 'ERROR') AND (ECM_RESULT = #{ECM_YN} OR ECM_RESULT = 'ALL') AND DOCUMENT_YN = #{DOCUMENT_YN} ORDER BY SIMPLE_DOC_NO DESC
